project: Chronic Cardiovascular Risk Analysis using Wearable Biosensors and Clinical Data

clinical_meaning.Low: 88% of patients — routine annual monitoring. NPV>99%.
clinical_meaning.Mild: ~8.7% of patients — 6-month follow-up. High K indicates uncertainty.
clinical_meaning.High: ~10% of patients — immediate clinical review. Sensitivity matched to catch true risk.

note_on_mild_class: The Mild class captures patients in the uncertain intermediate zone (0.15-0.38). These patients have higher local uncertainty u_1 and higher conflict mass K on average. Clinical recommendation: 6-month follow-up and repeat biosensor assessment.
